question: Should Control UI permanently support `/new --name <title>` as its named-session creation command?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and compatibility-conscious, but adding a public surface-specific command form is a product contract that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close this technically sound implementation without rejecting the idea, and reopen it if a Control UI owner sponsors the command contract.

options.title: Sponsor explicit option
options.body: Confirm `/new --name <title>` as the Control UI grammar and reopen or refresh this branch for landing.

options.title: Require create then rename
options.body: Keep `/new` anonymous and direct users to the existing `/name <title>` command after creation.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close this technically sound implementation without rejecting the idea, and reopen it if a Control UI owner sponsors the command contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent sustained ownership of the Control UI chat and session surfaces makes this the strongest product-decision routing signal.
